title: Equivalence of Affine-Space Embeddings Under Automorphisms
exact_target: Given embeddings $f,g:\mathbb C^d\hookrightarrow\mathbb C^n$, does there exist an automorphism $\Psi:\mathbb C^n\to\mathbb C^n$ such that $\Psi\circ f=g$?
